source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of vascular disorders and stroke (PDF 49-50).

blocks.text: Nervous system ki vascular (khoon ki nalyon wali) bimariyan woh halatein hain jin mein dimagh aur spinal cord ki khoon ki nalyan mutasir hoti hain. Misalein stroke aur cerebral venous thrombosis (dimagh ki vein mein khoon ka lothra) hain.

Stroke ka matlab hai dimagh ke kisi hisse ko khoon ki supply ruk jane se dimagh ke cells ka nuqsan. Yeh rukawat dimagh ki kisi khoon ki nali ke band hone (blockage) ya phatne (rupture) se ho sakti hai. Stroke ki wajahon (causes) mein high blood pressure, tambakoo noshi (smoking), ziabetes (diabetes), zyada cholesterol, motapa (obesity) aur khandan mein stroke ki tareekh shamil hain. Stroke ki alamaat (symptoms) dimagh ke mutasira hisse par munhasir hain. Falij (paralysis) jism ki us taraf hota hai jo cerebral infarction (tissue ki maut) ke mukhalif ho. Doosri aam alamaat aphasia (alfaaz mein baat na kar sakna), achanak dekhne aur chalne mein mushkil, chakkar aana, tawazun (balance) ka khatam hona aur shadeed sar dard hain.

blocks.alt: Dimagh aur us ke do mutasira hisse, aagay neela aur peeche laal. Har aik ko khuli hui artery ki shakal mein bara dikhaya gaya hai: baayen khoon ka lothra (clot) artery band karta hai (Blockage); daayen artery ki deewar phatne se khoon bahar nikalta hai (Rupture). Dono arteries ki deewar par charbi jami hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 15.21: Stroke ki bari qismein (kitab ki Figure 15.21 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Do qismein dekhein: baayen tasveer mein lothra (clot) artery ko band kar raha hai (Blockage: ischemic stroke); daayen tasveer mein artery phat kar khoon bahar nikal raha hai (Rupture: haemorrhagic stroke). Dono mein dimagh ke us hisse tak khoon nahin pohanchta.

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat ke liye)
blocks.text:
Ischemic stroke tab hota hai jab dimagh ki khoon ki nalyan tang ya band ho jati hain.
Haemorrhagic stroke tab hota hai jab dimagh ki koi khoon ki nali rees jati ya phat jati hai.
Transient ischemic attack (ministroke) dimagh ke kisi hisse ki khoon ki supply mein aarzi kami se hota hai, jo sirf paanch minute tak bhi reh sakti hai.

Dimagh ka nuqsan kam se kam rakhne ke liye ilaj (treatment) jitni jaldi ho sake diya jana chahiye. Ilaj mein yeh shamil ho sakte hain: dawayein (jaise khoon patla karne wali, lothra ghulane wali ya blood pressure kam karne wali dawayein); khoon ka lothra nikalne ya phati hui nali ki marammat ki surgery; aur rehabilitation (bahali, taa ke mareez jismani aur zehni salahiyat wapas pa sake).

blocks.prompt: Baayen cerebral hemisphere ka stroke jism ki kaun si taraf falij karta hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Daayen taraf, kyun ke har hemisphere jism ki mukhalif taraf ko motor hukm bhejta hai.

items: Stroke: khoon ki supply rukne se dimagh ke cells ka nuqsan (ischemic: nali band; haemorrhagic: nali phati; TIA: aarzi kami). Wajahein: high blood pressure, smoking, diabetes, cholesterol, motapa. Mukhalif taraf falij, aphasia. Fauri ilaj: dawayein, surgery, rehabilitation.
